name: new-untyped-record
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1} without typed
PlistGetXML p
PlistGet p
PlistClose p

name: new-untyped-text
script:
set p to PlistNew {t:"x"} without typed
PlistGetXML p
PlistGet p key "t" as text
PlistClose p

name: new-untyped-real
script:
set p to PlistNew {v:2.5} without typed
PlistGetXML p
PlistGet p key "v"
PlistClose p

name: new-untyped-boolean
script:
set p to PlistNew {v:true} without typed
PlistGetXML p
PlistGet p key "v"
PlistClose p

name: new-untyped-date
script:
set p to PlistNew {v:date "Saturday, January 1, 2000 at 12:00:00 AM"} without typed
PlistGetXML p
PlistGet p key "v"
PlistClose p

name: new-untyped-list
script:
set p to PlistNew {v:{1, 2}} without typed
PlistGetXML p
PlistGet p key "v"
PlistClose p

name: new-untyped-integer
script:
set p to PlistNew {v:7} without typed
PlistGetXML p
PlistGet p key "v"
PlistClose p

name: open-big-numbers
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/big.plist")
PlistGet p
PlistGetXML p
PlistClose p

name: get-big-numbers
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/big.plist")
PlistGet p key "big"
PlistGet p key "huge"
PlistGet p key "small"
PlistClose p

name: set-key-list-missing-value-kept
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
PlistSet p key {"a", "b"} to {5, missing value} without suppressing
PlistGetXML p
PlistClose p

name: remove-then-use-removed
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
set c to PlistChild p key "d"
PlistRemoveChild p key "d"
PlistGet c
PlistGetXML p
PlistClose p

name: save-string-path
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:1, l:{"x", "y"}, d:{e:1}}
PlistSave p in "$TMP/string-path.plist"
PlistClose p
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/string-path.plist")

name: json-types
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistToJSON p
PlistClose p

name: json-types-formatted
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
PlistToJSON p with formatting
PlistClose p

name: fromjson-object
script:
set p to PlistFromJSON "{\"a\": 1, \"b\": [true, false, null], \"c\": {\"d\": 2.5}, \"e\": \"text\"}"
PlistType p
PlistGetXML p
PlistClose p

name: filter-into
script:
set p to PlistNew {z:0}
filter text "^(\\w+)=(.*)$" in ("a=1" & linefeed & "b=2" & linefeed & "a=3") key "\\1" using "\\2" into p
PlistGetXML p
PlistClose p

name: filter-into-list
script:
set p to PlistNew {a:"old"}
filter text "^(\\w+)=(.*)$" in ("a=1" & linefeed & "b=2" & linefeed & "a=3") key "\\1" using "\\2" as list into p
PlistGetXML p
PlistClose p

name: filter-into-child
script:
set p to PlistNew {d:{z:0}}
filter text "^(\\w+)=(.*)$" in ("a=1" & linefeed & "b=2" & linefeed & "a=3") key "\\1" using "\\2" into (PlistChild p key "d")
PlistGetXML p
PlistClose p

name: filter-into-array
filter-into-closed
script:
set p to PlistNew
PlistClose p
filter text "^(\\w+)=(.*)$" in ("a=1" & linefeed & "b=2" & linefeed & "a=3") key "\\1" into p

name: child-using-trailing-slash
script:
set p to PlistOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.plist")
set c to PlistChild p using "dict/"
PlistGet c
PlistClose p
